name: TTS Tier Routing Collapse — Fast (Calibration)
description: Calibration recipe for TTS output tier routing. Given transcript .txt files, Stage 1 computes pure-Python readability complexity features (avg sentence len, word len, type-token ratio — no model required) and clusters into 3 tiers: fast (low complexity → bonfyre-narrate default), standard (medium complexity → tone-aware narrate), quality (high complexity / rich vocabulary → narrate --verify --refine). Stage 2 embeds with MiniLM. Stage 3 collapses to an ONNX head that routes each text input to the appropriate TTS execution tier without running the full narration pipeline. Use with demo_speech_loop.py --tts-head to make the TTS call adaptive.
